# A partnership to accelerate your growth

Your Intercom app is just the start. Partner with us today to unlock revenue-driving sales and marketing opportunities.

[Build your app](https://developers.intercom.com/docs)

![Image 2: Ink illustration of two gardeners tending a flower bed](https://www.intercom.com/ims-image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Fimages%2F4bgok82s%2Fmonorepo-static-assets%2Fba8f4cb0f52cadc6cdea00e7ccdc28ea23bd9dfc-840x840.webp&w=1920&q=75)

## Why partner with Intercom?

01
### Close more deals

Win more opportunities with our 100+ sales reps recommending your app to top companies worldwide.

02
### Generate new leads

Grow shared customers by going to market with the #1-rated tool for live chat.

03
### Retain more customers

Improve customer experience with early access to our APIs and sneak peeks of our platform roadmap.

04
### Get insider access

Learn about partnership opportunities and connect with us through our newsletter and community.

Used by 30,000+ companies like:

## What do our technology partners get?

Our tiered program brings value to your partnership at any level. Here are just a few of our benefits.

01
### Technology Partner

Dedicated app reports, early access to APIs, eligible for inclusion in our New & Noteworthy collection, and more.

[See full benefits list](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/68yer78tmakt3098yezg3/Intercom-App-Partner-Program-Overview.pdf?rlkey=mtyin47mwk913r2w35nm0eum8&e=1&dl=0)

02
### Technology Partner Plus

Featured placement in our customer newsletter, designated as a preferred partner to our sales team, and more.

[See full benefits list](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/68yer78tmakt3098yezg3/Intercom-App-Partner-Program-Overview.pdf?rlkey=mtyin47mwk913r2w35nm0eum8&e=1&dl=0)

03
### Premier Technology Partner

Custom sales collaboration and co-marketing plans, eligible for joint content, events, and more.

[See full benefits list](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/68yer78tmakt3098yezg3/Intercom-App-Partner-Program-Overview.pdf?rlkey=mtyin47mwk913r2w35nm0eum8&e=1&dl=0)

## Who can join?

Any company with an app in the Intercom App Store can join as long as it meets our app and listing guidelines, has a Start Guide, and completes the Technology Partner Program details section.

[See requirements for each tier](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/68yer78tmakt3098yezg3/Intercom-App-Partner-Program-Overview.pdf?rlkey=mtyin47mwk913r2w35nm0eum8&e=2&dl=0)

## How to join

Step 01
### Build

Build an app or platform.

[Build your app](https://developers.intercom.com/docs)

Step 02
### Complete

Complete the Technology Partner section.

[Build your app](https://developers.intercom.com/docs)

Step 03
### Publish

Publish it on the Intercom App Store.

[Build your app](https://developers.intercom.com/docs)
